scan.attribution: case findings minus the same server's empty-tools control, on (rule_id, evidence)
scan.project: one .mcp.json: mcpServers.<dataset server name>.tools = [the case's tool]

definitions.any_rule: at least one finding attributed to the case's tool, from any rule
definitions.at_or_above: at least one attributed finding at or above the given severity (what --fail-on gates on)
definitions.by_rule: the cases each rule fired on, attributed
definitions.tool_poisoning: at least one attributed finding from a rule in Category.TOOL_POISONING
